mentions.name: Solenoid
mentions.description: Solenoid is a sales outreach tool that helps builders reach out to people with more buying intent, aimed at engineers learning and doing sales.
mentions.problem: Builders coming from software engineering backgrounds struggle to reach out to people with more buying intent when doing sales.
mentions.audience: Builders (e.g., makers and founders) doing sales outreach to potential customers with buying intent.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://getsolenoid.com/ to help the builders reach out to people with more buying intend.

evidence.value: Working on https://getsolenoid.com/ to help the builders reach out to people with more buying intend.
